title: BetterOptimized
description: A Modpack to optimize minecraft So You Can Get Higher FPS On LowEnd Devices
body:
## **Requires JDK 22!**

**A basic optimization modpack to Boost Your FPS, Give Performance And Some Life Quality Mods Are Added. And More**

**Modpack is made to help users who cant play higher versions or gets low performance due to them having a LowEnd Devices. The Modpack Boosts Performance By 1.5x To 2.0x, Main performance mods are Sodium, Sodium Extra, Reese's Sodium Settings, Cull Leaves, More Culling**

**Enjoy the modpack.**
